## p117 A — Clarify a reported medical company versus a field hospital

**Edition context:** Medical-company report and a request for clarification.

<a id="edition-cases-people-medical-company-inquiry-medical-company-report-and-a-request-for-clarification"></a>

<a id="source-p117-a"></a>

### p117 A

The source is addressed to the leading medical officer of the German
Caucasus delegation. The page heading is 3 November, the origin says
`1807 (3)`, and the receipt line says **5 November**. The published key remains
labelled Nov1–3; this delayed/conflicting receipt does not extend its date
range. The middle letter of the printed `POT` call sign may be Q.

<details>
<summary>Source and cipher evidence</summary>

**Raw output — native source frame**

```text
IMDORTXBERICHTNR1314E16VOM29X9XISTEINESANITXKOMPXNR30ERWAEHNTXSOVIELHIERBEKANNTISTNUREIN9ELDLAZARETTDORTXSOFORTDRAHTAUFK?AERUNGX?TSCHXFELDSANITXCHE?XGHQ38302X18
```

**Edited output**

```text
IMDORTXBERICHTNR1314E16VOM29X9XISTEINESANITXKOMPXNR30ERWAEHNTXSOVIELHIERBEKANNTISTNUREINFELDLAZARETTDORTXSOFORTDRAHTAUFKLAERUNGXDTSCHXFELDSANITXCHEFXGHQ38302X18
```

</details>

Price: 1 observed-coordinate substitution, 3 source-mask fills.

**Readable German — based on the edited output**

> Im dort. Bericht Nr. `1314E16` vom `29X9` ist eine Sanit.Komp. Nr.30 erwaehnt. Soviel hier bekannt, ist nur ein Feldlazarett dort. Sofort Drahtaufklaerung. Dtsch. Feldsanit. Chef. `GHQ38302X18`.

The message asks for urgent clarification of a reported medical company
because the sender knows only of a field hospital. `9ELD`→`FELD` is one
priced observed-coordinate repair. The three printed dashes supply L in
`AUFKLAERUNG`, D in `DTSCH`, and F in `CHEF`. The shorthand, unit label 30
and references are retained; no further digit or institutional identification
is inferred. Spacing and punctuation in the readable paragraph are editorial.

### p117 B

The header is `OUI v OSM`, received at 1.20 a.m. on 4 November, with origin
`1900 (3) SSD`. Its unenciphered reception note says that only the first
item was found, that Nr2 could not be copied, and that the characters ran
together. It requests another transmission. No missing second item is supplied.

<details>
<summary>Source and cipher evidence</summary>

**Raw output — native source frame**

```text

```

**Edited output**

```text
NACHRCEFXAUSSERVONFALKENHAUSENGENANNTENZEITENWIRDXYSZUDENALTENRINGBAHNZEITENAUFLPHOERENXIMMERINNAECHSTERPERIODEWDHXNURNOCHITOCHI
```

</details>

Price: 1 observed-coordinate substitution, 0 source-mask fills.

**Readable German — based on the edited output**

> Nachrcef. Ausser von Falkenhausen genannten Zeiten wird `YS` zu den alten Ringbahnzeiten auf LP hoeren. Immer in naechster Periode wdh. `NURNOCHITOCHI`.

Only `W8RD`→`WIRD` is repaired. This is a local spelling change, without
relabeling that square cell in other occurrences. The received shortened
`NACHRCEF`, literal `YS`, abbreviation `WDH` and unexplained closing
`NURNOCHITOCHI` remain visible. The paragraph does not identify YS as a
particular station or manufacture a cleaner ending. All 256 source slots
are valid coordinates; the cipher frame itself is unchanged.
